msgs:
CHEERS TO A
BRAND NEW YEAR

May the new year
be better than
the last

New year:
a blank page.
Write it well

Leave all the bad
in the old year

Pine and
cinnamon:
the smell of winter

Presents under
the tree. No peeking! {r}

Wishing all your
dreams come true

A winter fairy
tale starts today

Merry Christmas
and a Happy
New Year!

New year:
time to say thanks

Thank you,
old year.
Hello, new one!

Happy New Year!
Hugs to all

Holiday table
is ready!
Let's celebrate

May the year be
generous with joy

New year wish:
more time with
loved ones

Happy New Year!
May luck
be with you

The new year
comes quietly,
like snow

Happy New Year!
May all be well

Wish boldly:
the new year
is listening

Happiness: everyone
home at the
holiday table

May the new year
bring peace to
every home

Happy New Year!
Time for
new plans

May luck never
leave your side

Wishing you joy
for no reason

Happy New Year!
All the best

Happy New Year!
May wishes
come true

New year:
a reason to
be better

May your home
be full
and warm

Time to believe
in fairy tales

New things
lead to
better things

There's still time
to make a wish

Wishing you true
friends and
big plans

Time to switch
on the lights

New Year is a
family holiday

May wishes come
true fast,
like snow melts

May every
present be
a wanted one

Strength and
patience for
the whole year

Merry Christmas
and Happy
New Year!

May the new year
bring meetings
with dear people

May the new year
bring what you
waited for

May the year
pass in joy

Greet the year
with a smile

May the new year
warm your soul

May the fairy tale
never end

Made a wish?
Keep it secret

A year full of
tasty dinners

Today we can
believe in magic

Hot tea,
a tangerine,
a favorite film

Snow on New Year's
is a good sign

May the year
give you reasons
to be proud

Wishing peace
and goodness to all

Start the year
with a smile
